profile.jobTitle: Principal Web Developer & Systems Administrator, U.S. Army Geospatial Center contact
profile.summary:
Chung has over 27 years of experience as a Software Engineer/Developer and Web/UI Developer. He helps his customers succeed by utilizing his skill set which includes HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AngularJS, JQuery, JSON, XML, Java, C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET, ColdFusion, SQL, PL/SQL, MVC, SharePoint, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, version control, Agile software methodology, unit testing, requirements analysis, and technical documentation.

Chung earned a graduate certificate in data mining. Through this graduate program, he acquired the skills and hands-on experience with Weka, data mining, data analysis, machine learning, neural networks, pattern recognition, and R programming. Chung is looking forward to a successful transition into the Big Data field as well as providing greater value to his customers.

Chung possesses an active TS/SCI security clearance.
